conflicts_or_tensions: IR-MCP-014 AC-2 currently defines smart_search limit default 10, while the new requirement sets MCP search default to 20.
CON-MCP-003 depends on IR-MCP-014, so superseding IR-MCP-014 requires a refreshed seven-tool parity constraint.

DR-APP-002 and FR-DOC-020 forbid silent destructive rebuilds; the new flow must treat Connect/Remove confirmation as the explicit user action that authorizes semantic invalidation and background indexing.
